scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @syncspace/server" "npm run dev -w @syncspace/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @syncspace/server && npm run build -w @syncspace/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @syncspace/server && npm run typecheck -w @syncspace/web
scripts.dev:demo: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "ALLOW_FILE_STORAGE=true npm run dev -w @syncspace/server" "npm run dev -w @syncspace/web"
scripts.postinstall: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate
